articles.title: DOJ sues to block Alaska from certifying Senate race winner if Republican narrowly loses
articles.description: There are two Dan Sullivans on the ballot in the Senate race in Alaska. The DOJ says that fact could help Democratic nominee Mary Peltola defeat both of them.

articles.title: Musk's SpaceX is still restricting Starlink in Ukraine and the toll is rising

articles.title: American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce to 'prepare for AI'
